quotes.text: 2 cuidar o atender sin pago, de manera exclusiva, a niños, ancianos, enfermos o discapacitados? (bañarlos, cambiarlos)

assessments.reasoning: Question 9, item 2 of Section IX (Otras actividades) in the Cuestionario de Ocupación y Empleo asks about time spent caring for children, elderly, sick, or disabled household members exclusively ('de manera exclusiva'). The questionnaire does not contain any item asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while doing other activities or without care being their primary activity.
